text.tspan: Snow, Lamp, Bridge: set map, top-down
Generated from src/set.js, src/world.js and src/shots.js. Stage 1 storyboard, for your markup.
RIVER (flows east to west, water 6 m below the deck)
CITY, south bank (receding east into fog)
180 degree line (A and B), glance cameras stay WEST
moon, azimuth 84 deg, clears the haze at 1:08
sight line from camera 3 past the corner
Numbered circles are cameras. Solid wedge: field of view at the shot
start, reaching the subject. Dashed wedge: at the shot end.
Arrow: camera move. North is up.
Wind blows from the east-north-east toward the street side.
